i.norm: Verifies that {@link JsonSetter.Value#valueFor()} reports the annotation type it carries information for, namely the {@link JsonSetter} annotation interface. The expected modifiers value (9729) is the {@code java.lang.reflect.Modifier} bitmask that the JVM assigns to the {@code JsonSetter} annotation type: public (0x0001) + final (0x0010) + interface (0x0200) + abstract (0x0400) + annotation (0x2000) = 9729.
